items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: on trumpet I wanted to be Wingy Manone for a long time.

ctx.x: Well on different instruments, on trumpet I wanted to be Wingy Manone for a long time. You know, one arm.
I’m glad you didn’t take up that part of it.
